question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'internal'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the** 'Human Skeleton System'.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the first blank is** 'internal'.**
 
• It means *of or on the inside (of a place, person or object). [(स्‍थान, व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के) भीतर के या भीतर में, अंदरूनी, भीतरी, आंतरिक]*__
 
• Human skeleton is **the internal skeleton** that serves as a framework for the body consists of many individual bones and cartilages. 
 
• Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer.

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

__
 
• 'external' means 'connected with the outside of something'. (बाहरी हिस्‍से का, बाहर स्थित, बाह्य)

 
 
• *Example: The cream is for external use only [to be used on the skin].*
 
 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **superficial**: not studying or thinking about something in a deep or complete way. (जिसे गहराई से या पूर्णता में न जाना या सोचा गया हो; छिछला, उथला)
 
• **middle**: the part, point or position that is at about the same distance from the two ends or sides of something. [किसी वस्‍तु का मध्य भाग (किसी वस्‍तु के दो छोरों से समान दूरी पर स्थित उसका अंश; बिंदु या स्थिति)] 
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the above definition, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *The human skeleton is the **internal** framework of our body. It gives shape and support to the body. (2)______, it provides protection, makes blood cells, stores minerals and regulates hormones. The spinal cord is an (3)______ part of our body. The ribcage protects our lungs and heart. To increase the (4)______ of our bones, we should include calcium in our diet. All our (5)______ organs are protected by this skeletal system.*

43:Ta1e,

The correct answer is '**Besides**'.
